name: Marc Vidal Serra
headline: Senior Backend Engineer
summary: Senior Backend Engineer with 7 years of experience designing and building scalable server-side systems and APIs. Strong background in Python, relational databases, and containerized deployments. Comfortable leading technical decisions, mentoring junior engineers, and collaborating cross-functionally to deliver reliable, maintainable software.

responsibilities: Lead development of core backend services handling high-throughput transaction processing
Design and optimize PostgreSQL schemas and queries for performance at scale
Own containerization strategy using Docker and orchestration with Kubernetes
Mentor mid-level and junior engineers through code reviews and pairing sessions
Collaborate with product and frontend teams to define API contracts
Developed and maintained RESTful APIs using Django and Django REST Framework
Migrated legacy monolithic services into modular microservices
Implemented caching layers with Redis to reduce database load
Wrote automated tests and participated in CI/CD pipeline improvements
Built internal tools and scripts to automate data processing tasks
Assisted senior engineers in maintaining backend services
Fixed bugs and implemented small features in existing Python applications
